g.title: cluster_core
g.text: PyTorch (CUDA or CPU), scikit-learn, XGBoost, statsmodels, OR-Tools, elkai

g.title: note
g.text: Environments communicate only through Parquet artifacts.
TensorFlow is never imported in env core;
a generator whose modules are missing is skipped
with a hint, not an error (run_in_env in Colab).
